raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

Bump the maximum supported FlashAttention version from v2.8.3 to v2.8.4.

Currently, Transformer Engine (TE) caps FlashAttention at v2.8.3. However, newer commits on the FlashAttention main branch include changes that would be useful to TE users, such as those introduced in [Dao-AILab/flash-attention#2260](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/pull/2260).

Allowing FlashAttention v2.8.4 enables users to use TE with newer FlashAttention releases. I ran the test suite with the updated version, and the results were largely successful. The few failures appear to be related to my specific environment rather than the version bump itself.

Was there a specific reason for guarding against newer FlashAttention releases, or was it mainly intended to guard against potential API changes?

## Changes

* Increase the maximum supported FlashAttention version from v2.8.3 to v2.8.4.
* Validate the change with the existing test suite.

Allows FlashAttention 2.8.4 while keeping 2.8.5 outside the supported range. - Transformer Engine now accepts FlashAttention 2.8.4. - L3 runs now include pinned FlashAttention 2.8.4. Reviews (8) · Last reviewed commit: ["Build the L3 FA2 iteration from a pinned..."](https://github.com/nvidia/transformerengine/commit/1ece04db6b97a0ada8193abe6245539f4396b2ba) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_expert&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=code_reviews&utm_content=nvidia/transformerengine)

```
+ pip3 install flash-attn==2.8.4 --no-build-isolation
ERROR: Ignored the following yanked versions: 1.0.3
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement flash-attn==2.8.4 
```
Could you confirm this is the correct latest version?
Want your agent to iterate on Greptile's feedback? Try [*greploops*](https://github.com/greptileai/skills/blob/main/greploop/SKILL.md).

Version `2.8.4` has not been published to any PyPI index yet, but the version on the `main` branch is already set to `2.8.4`.

You can verify this in [`[flash_attn/__init__.py](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/blob/1fc0221183e799363001394a12dd9e78e15f5dda/flash_attn/__init__.py#L6)`](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/blob/1fc0221183e799363001394a12dd9e78e15f5dda/flash_attn/__init__.py#L6).

To install it directly from the `main` branch, run:

```bash
pip install --no-build-isolation "git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention.git@main"
```
FA 2.8.4 is not released yet, but if one builds FA from source, they will get the 2.8.4 versioning. Just added the build instructions to L3 for CI testing purposes. Thanks.
The H100 hang in CI is not related to this PR. Merging.

**FlashAttention 2.8.4 lacks runtime coverage** These cases only exercise the version predicate, while the architecture-driven L3 matrix installs FA3 or FA4 rather than the newly admitted FlashAttention 2.8.4 package. A 2.8.4-specific regression in the private imports or call signatures used by TE would therefore pass recurring CI and reach users unnoticed. **Knowledge Base Used:** - [PyTorch Attention Stack](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/pytorch-attention.md) - [Tests and QA](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/tests-and-qa.md) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

@@ -31,16 +31,20 @@ export NVTE_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PICKLE_EXTRA_STATE=1
 # Iterate over Flash Attention versions
 sm_arch=`python3 -c "import torch; sm = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0); print(sm[0]*10+sm[1])"`
 export FLASH_ATTN_CUDA_ARCHS=$sm_arch
-# Run one architecture-owned FlashAttention generation. sm90 keeps the mature
-# FA3 path, while sm100+ exercises the FA4 CP support enabled by this change.
+# FA2: routine tests are in L0 and L1; sm90 and sm100+; non-CP and CP
+#      targeted tests are here; e.g. 2.8.4 pinned commit, non-CP
+# FA3: routine tests are here; sm90 only; non-CP and CP
+# FA4: routine tests are here; sm100+ only; non-CP and CP
+FA2_SOURCE_VERSION="2.8.4"
+FA2_SOURCE_COMMIT="1fc0221183e799363001394a12dd9e78e15f5dda"
 CP_FA_VERSION=""
 if [ $sm_arch -gt 90 ]
 then
-  FA_versions=(4.0.0b33)
+  FA_versions=(2.8.4 4.0.0b33)
   CP_FA_VERSION="4.0.0b33"
 elif [ $sm_arch -eq 90 ]
 then
-  FA_versions=(3.0.0b1)
+  FA_versions=(2.8.4 3.0.0b1)
   CP_FA_VERSION="3.0.0b1"
 else
   error_exit "No L3 FlashAttention generation is defined for sm${sm_arch}"
@@ -61,8 +65,21 @@ do
   if [ "${fa_version}" \< "3.0.0" ]
   then
     export NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V2=1
-    pip3 install flash-attn==${fa_version} --no-build-isolation \
-      || error_exit "Failed to install Flash Attention $fa_version"
+    if [ "${fa_version}" = "$FA2_SOURCE_VERSION" ]
+    then
+      pip3 install --no-build-isolation \
+        "git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention.git@${FA2_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \
+        || error_exit "Failed to install Flash Attention $fa_version from ${FA2_SOURCE_COMMIT}"
+    else
+      pip3 install flash-attn==${fa_version} --no-build-isolation \
+        || error_exit "Failed to install Flash Attention $fa_version"
+    fi
+    installed=$(python3 -c "import flash_attn; print(flash_attn.__version__)") \
+      || error_exit "Failed to import Flash Attention $fa_version"
+    if [ "$installed" != "${fa_version}" ]
+    then
+      error_exit "Flash Attention installed is $installed but this iteration expects ${fa_version}"
+    fi
   elif [[ "${fa_version}" == 4.* ]]
   then
     export NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V4=1
